It is NP-complete to decide for a bipartite graph G with parts X and Y and an integer k whether there exist k-element subsets X ′ ⊆ X and Y ′ ⊆ Y such that X ′ ∪ Y ′ is independent [43]. For an input bipartite graph G, let G′ be the graph obtained from G by adding all edges between the vertices of X and between the vertices of Y . We claim that the existence of such subsets X ′ and Y ′ is equivalent to each of the following four statements: The matroid 2MF (G′ ) has contraction-depth at most |X| + |Y | − k + 1.
